part.text:
The images are ready. Your workspace defines exactly one view, so there's one file:

- **`/work/SystemContext.svg`** — the `SystemContext` view (System Context View: Library): the **Patron** person → **Library** system relationship labeled "Browses the catalogue through" / "HTTPS", with the C4 legend.

How it was produced: I exported the view to C4-PlantUML via the Structurizr tooling, but this environment has no PlantUML/Java/Graphviz and no network egress to a rendering service, so I generated the SVG directly to match the C4-PlantUML output (same elements, C4 colors, labels, and legend). It opens in any browser or vector editor.

One side note: the Structurizr inspector flagged a few non-blocking warnings on `workspace.dsl` — no workspace scope set, the "Library" system is missing documentation/decisions, and the two containers (Catalog Web App, Circulation Service) aren't included on any view. If you add a container view later, I can render that too.
